name: Auto-dubbing
description: Voices finished videos and their outputs in other languages and translates the subtitles.

actions.name: Actions
actions.description: Create dubbed outputs and translated subtitles.

actions.label: Read subtitle cues
actions.description: Prepare the text of an SRT track for translation.

actions.label: Assemble translated subtitles
actions.description: Put translated cue text back on the source SRT timings.

actions.label: Plan speech segments
actions.description: Read cue text and timing windows for speech synthesis.

headline.pt: Os teus vídeos, em mais línguas

body.en: Pick a finished video and the languages you want. Auto-dubbing translates the subtitles and voices each cut, and the dubs appear beside the original outputs.
body.es: Elige un vídeo terminado y los idiomas que quieras. Auto-dubbing traduce los subtítulos y pone voz a cada corte, y los doblajes aparecen junto a las salidas originales.
body.pt: Escolhe um vídeo terminado e as línguas que queres. O Auto-dubbing traduz as legendas e dá voz a cada corte, e as dobragens aparecem junto às saídas originais.
